Senate Bill 485 By: Senators Payne of the 54th, Anavitarte of the 31st, Kirkpatrick of the 32nd, Setzler of the 37th, Robertson of the 29th and others
AS PASSED SENATE A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 1 of Chapter 10A of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to examination regarding professional counselors, social workers, and marriage and family therapists, so as … examination in such applicant's final semester of the program. The board may adopt rules and regulations to administer the provisions of this subsection."
SECTION 2. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
